assumptions.assumption: 'Pricier-to-replace films with 20.99 as the cutoff' means replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 (the cutoff itself excluded).

The final row is an unweighted average of the per-rating averages (each rating counts equally), not an average over all films. Rows with a NULL rating are excluded so only real rating groups are included.

assumptions.assumption: 'Pricier-to-replace with 20.99 as the cutoff' means strictly greater than 20.99 (replacement_cost > 20.99), so films at exactly 20.99 are excluded.

The final row is the unweighted mean of the per-rating averages (each rating counts equally), not a film-level average. The per-rating step is computed inside a CTE, and only the final row is returned.
Films with a NULL rating are excluded, since they have no rating group. NULL values in the averaged columns are ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive: films with replacement_cost >= 20.99 count as pricier-to-replace.

assumptions.assumption: 'Pricier-to-replace with 20.99 as the cutoff' means strictly greater than 20.99 (replacement_cost > 20.99), so films costing exactly 20.99 are excluded.

The final row is an unweighted average of the per-rating averages (each rating counts equally), not an average over all qualifying films. The per-rating figures are computed in a CTE and only the final one-row result is returned.
